rule: Exact versions only. A dependency must be promoted into package.json and the package-manager lockfile before the first source import that consumes it.
notes: B0 itself uses only Node built-ins so its package-lock remains dependency-free and reproducible offline.

B7 freshness correction on 2026-08-19 verified official npm distribution pages and the temporalio/sdk-typescript v1.22.0 tag. The intermediate 1.21.1 baseline was based on stale GitHub release indexing and was never promoted into package.json/source imports.
Temporal's official repository requires all @temporalio/* packages in one project to use the same version; the B7 family is pinned uniformly to 1.22.0.
@temporalio/common is included because the official SDK installation guidance includes it in client/worker package sets.
The B7 source-import gate remains closed until package.json and a trustworthy transitive npm package-lock are generated for these exact pins.
No caret, tilde, wildcard, latest or next specifiers are allowed.
